title: Strategies for Integrating Disparate Social Information

participants.population: United States Amazon Mechanical Turk workers
eligibility: at least 95% prior MTurk approval rate

design.type: within-participant repeated visual estimation and belief revision

conditions.HF: high variance with peers clustered far from the participant
conditions.HC: high variance with peers clustered close to the participant
conditions.filler: additional distributions outside the focal 2-by-skew comparisons

one_peer_control: Present the source-derived instructions and require all four comprehension answers to be correct.
Show a deterministic animal image in one multimodal first-estimate call.
Collect an independent first estimate from 1 through 150, then remove the image.
Use the published target-and-nearest-pool rule to show one prerecorded estimate.
Collect a second estimate from 1 through 150 without accuracy feedback.
main_task: Present the source-derived instructions and require all four comprehension answers to be correct.
Show a deterministic animal image in one multimodal first-estimate call.
Collect an independent first estimate from 1 through 150.
Use the published round-by-estimate lookup to show three prerecorded MTurk estimates.
Collect a second estimate from 1 through 150 without accuracy feedback.
four_peer_control: Present the source-derived instructions and require all four comprehension answers to be correct.
Do not show an image or elicit a personal first estimate.
Sample one valid prerecorded anchor from the published round-specific pool.
Use the published lookup to add three more estimates.
Collect one estimate integrating the four displayed estimates.
procedure.block_order: Participant numbers cycle through the six published permutations of the one-peer, main, and four-peer blocks.
procedure.feedback: No accuracy feedback is shown between rounds.

response_measures.peer_mean: mean of the peer estimates shown in the current block

payment.selection: One round from each of the three original task blocks was randomly selected for payment.

model_calls.comprehension: one call before each of the three blocks when answered correctly on the first attempt
model_calls.one_peer_control: two per round: visual first estimate and text-only revision
model_calls.main_task: two per round: visual first estimate and text-only revision
